name: sleek-shop
description: Sleek Shop: installable storefront, customer accounts and admin console, backed by Turso.

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @sleek/api" "npm run dev -w @sleek/web"
